# AWS long-tail services

<!-- Generated by `go test ./internal/aws/generic -run Coverage -update`; do not edit. -->

Every service below is emulated from its botocore model by `internal/aws/generic`. For each one the test
takes the main resource the engine infers from the operation names, builds the smallest valid input from the
model's required members, and drives create, get, list and delete as raw protocol requests. It asserts no 5xx,
that the created resource is listed, and that after the delete a get is not-found. Hand-written overrides
are part of the run: this is what a client gets today, not what the engine alone does. Some of these services
also have their own row on [Coverage](coverage.md), so this table is longer than that page's long tail row.

70 services: 57 pass, 3 overridden (validated by their own tests), 0 fail, 10 with no inferable resource.
